quantitative_calculation.description: Formulas, units, intermediate values, derived indicators, numeric comparisons, thresholds, ratios, and reproducible Python/statistical calculation.

physical_mechanism.description: Dominant hazard mechanism, mechanism arbitration, physically plausible drivers, and rejection of unsupported physical explanations.

spatiotemporal_process.description: Event timing, duration, stage boundaries, peak windows, spatial extent, propagation, and local-versus-regional process structure.

multi_source_evidence.description: Selection and integration of package evidence across reports, weather files, tables, catalogs, traces, rasters, vectors, or other local sources. This dimension also covers evidence sufficiency, source conflict, robustness, sensitivity, counterfactual exclusion, and bounded inference.

causal_chain.description: Trigger-to-process-to-surface-response-to-receptor/system-pressure-to-outcome reasoning, including chain reconstruction and control points.

ranking_decision.description: Ranking, priority ordering, mechanism dominance ordering, scenario sensitivity ordering, control-point ordering, and decision-oriented structured comparison.

remote_sensing_geospatial.description: Use of images, pixels, pre/event remote-sensing pairs, AOI/vector/raster summaries, geospatial exposure/surface-change statistics, and spatial product interpretation.
